body:
**Tier:** T4
**Why:** Coach-facing money surface (earnings, payouts, failed payments, refunds/disputes, Stripe Express dashboard link) reading live payment read models; retires the Earnings screen whose client called six routes that never shipped.
**T4 trigger scan:** money display and payment state (yes), Stripe Connect dashboard link (yes, opened only after `assertStripeUrl`), payouts copy (yes). No auth, schema, migration, secret or production config change.
**T3 trigger scan:** navigation (old `CoachEarnings` and `CoachBusinessMetrics` routes now redirect to `CoachMoney`), Settings and Team profile entry points, shared `command-center/KpiTile` and `AlertRow` (additive props, label contrast).
**Bounded T1:** none.
**Builder-owner:** S-COACH-MOB-2 (agent 112, Opus). Builders do not audit their own change.
**Stacked on:** #329 (`agent/clinic/s-coach-wizard`). #329 fix round 2 (`83ee0e4`) is pushed and merged into this branch at `61eea11`, so this PR's diff is the Money work only (`5db9082`).
**Backend contract:** growth-project-backend#641 (`/v1/coach/money/summary|charges|charges/:id|attention`), plus live `/coach/connect/status|payouts|metrics` and `POST /v1/connect/accounts/dashboard-link`.

### What ships
- **Home Money card** (`components/coach/money/MoneyHomeCard.tsx`, on coach Home under the setup checklist): net to you over 30 days, change on the 30 days before, red needs-attention count, tap opens Money. Before Stripe: setup action. Error: specific copy, reference, retry. Offline: last numbers with a note.
- **Money page** (`screens/coach/money/MoneyScreen.tsx`): Today / 30 days / Year to date with previous-period change; net with breakdown (clients paid, card processing, TGP fee 2%, head coach share, refunds, net); amount held from the next sale shown only when the summary carries the #627 field (feature-detected, never invented); Needs attention (failed payments with try N of M, next retry, lock-out, card-update link state only when sent; disputes with evidence due date; Stripe requirements to setup); Payouts with next expected payout; Business numbers folded in (MRR, paying clients, new and canceled 30d, roster, joined 30d, team); recent charges, See all, per-charge breakdown.
- **Charges** (`MoneyChargesScreen`): All / Paid / Failed / Refunded, server cursor paging, empty copy per filter.
- **Charge** (`MoneyChargeScreen`): price to net breakdown, not-settled note, `MONEY_CHARGE_NOT_FOUND` copy, Message client.
- **Footer:** Payout settings (Stripe Express dashboard link; before Stripe is active it opens setup instead of a dead link) and Packages.
- **Retired:** `src/api/coachEarningsApi.ts`, `screens/coach/CoachEarningsScreen.tsx`, `screens/coach/CoachBusinessMetricsScreen.tsx` deleted; `CoachEarnings` and `CoachBusinessMetrics` routes render `MoneyRedirect` (`navigation.replace('CoachMoney')`). Settings, Billing section and Team profile now open Money. A test asserts no non-test source calls `/v1/coach/earnings`, `/v1/coach/payouts/readiness`, `/v1/coach/payouts`, `/v1/coach/reconciliation`, `/v1/coach/refunds`, `/v1/coach/dashboard-link`.

### Gaps (not built, by design)
- **CSV export:** no coach CSV route exists on backend main or #641, so no export entry point is shown.
- **Multi-currency:** client renders the summary's `currency`; AUD-SOL-5 B-641-3 may change the summary shape to group by currency. Client follow-up once #641's fix round lands.

### Acceptance evidence
- `/home/user/workspace/ops/heavy.sh npx jest --runInBand src/screens/coach/money src/components/coach/setup src/__tests__/paymentsConnectPackages.test.ts src/__tests__/coachSaasBlockers.test.ts`: 5 suites, 112 tests passed (at `61eea11`).
- `/home/user/workspace/ops/heavy.sh npx jest --runInBand src/__tests__/commandCenterNavigation.test.tsx src/__tests__/commandCenterScreens.test.tsx src/navigation/__tests__/imessageDmRoutes.test.tsx`: 3 suites, 41 passed.
- `/home/user/workspace/ops/heavy.sh npx jest --runInBand src/__tests__/quietLuxuryDoctrine.test.ts src/__tests__/CrossPillarSurface.test.ts`: 2 suites, 18 passed.
- `npx tsc --noEmit -p .` (one run via heavy.sh, because CI does not run on stacked PRs): exit 0.
- eslint on changed files: 0 errors (3 warnings, all in files this PR does not touch).

**CI:** this PR's base is not `main`, so required checks do not run here. Status: ready for CI once #329 merges and this PR is retargeted to `main`.

### Promotion triggers
Any change to how money amounts are computed on the client (it only formats server cents), any write call (this PR makes one: the dashboard-link POST), or any new route call would need a fresh T4 audit.
title: feat(money): coach Money page and Home Money card, retire Earnings and Business metrics
